data.one_liner: A Dart library to use the Web Bluetooth API in your projects.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to connect and interact with Bluetooth Low Energy devices from the browser. It compiles on native IO projects without conditional exports, though it only works in a browser.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web or Dart project that needs to interact with Bluetooth devices.
You want to share code across native and web platforms without conditional exports for Bluetooth.
avoid_when: You need native Bluetooth support directly on IO platforms without a browser.
The target browser does not support the experimental Web Bluetooth API.
strengths: Allows compiling on native platforms without throwing errors or requiring conditional exports.
Supports modern Dart web features like wasm builds via `dart:js_interop`.
weaknesses: Does not actually function for Bluetooth operations outside of a browser.
Requires experimental browser flags and secure contexts (HTTPS or localhost).
data.setup_notes: Requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) and enabling experimental web platform features in browsers like Chrome on Linux.
